284987681.description:
Natural Quartz Geode Specimens
Lot of 3 Raw Crystal Geode Pieces
Natural Mineral Rock Specimens
This collection features three natural quartz geode specimens showcasing sparkling crystalline interiors within rugged outer rinds. The lot includes one substantial nodule with an open crystallized cavity alongside two matching hollow halves of a split geode. These geological specimens highlight authentic druzy crystal formations and earthy matrix tones, making them ideal for mineral displays, educational study, or lapidary collections.
Three total pieces: one large geode nodule with cavity and two split geode halves
Natural crystalline interiors displaying translucent to white quartz crystal points and druzy texture
Rugged, unpolished natural stone exterior rinds showing earthy tan and brown mineral coloration
Combined lot weight of approximately 4.85 pounds; packaged dimensions measure approximately 11 x 5.5 x 5 inches
Condition:
Natural geological specimens in raw, unpolished state. Crystal interiors are well-defined with intact sparkling druzy and natural mineral matrix inclusions. Exterior stone rinds exhibit typical rough natural textures, weathering, and minor handling dust. No artificial dyes or synthetic enhancements observed.
